name: Unitree Go2
description: Unitree's mainstream quadruped robot dog, shipping across four tiers (Air / Pro / X / EDU) with chin-mounted 4D LiDAR, autonomous obstacle avoidance, and an app-based control ecosystem. The EDU tier adds full SDK access and an optional Jetson Orin module for custom development.

specs.label: Max Speed
specs.note: EDU tier; Air 2.5 m/s, Pro 3.5 m/s

sourcing: Specs sourced from Unitree's official product and shop pages (unitree.com/go2, shop.unitree.com), Unitree's original July 2023 launch release, and IEEE Spectrum's tier-by-tier coverage, as of September 2026. Max speed, payload, connectivity, and compute vary by tier — figures above reflect the specific tier noted, not a single universal spec. Go2 EDU has no public price; contact Unitree sales directly. robotindex does not sell this product.

pricing.summary: From **$1,600** (Go2 Air); Go2 Pro is **$2,800**, Go2 X is **$4,500**, and Go2 EDU is **contact-for-price** since Unitree does not list it publicly. Specs and features vary meaningfully by tier, so treat any single quoted price or spec as tier-specific — see the comparison below.

tiers.notes: Base config — no 4G, no follow-me mode, 6-month warranty
Adds 4G module, ISS 2.0 follow-me mode, voice function, 12-month warranty
Full developer SDK, force-sensor feet, optional Jetson Orin (40–100 TOPS)

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: All standard tiers ship with a chin-mounted 4D LiDAR (360°×90–96° coverage, 0.05m minimum range) for real-time obstacle avoidance and 3D mapping, paired with an HD wide-angle camera system and an onboard mic for offline voice commands. Compute is an 8-core CPU on Pro/X/EDU versus basic onboard computing on Air; EDU supports an external NVIDIA Jetson Orin module for custom AI.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Go2's four tiers differ far more than price: only the EDU tier includes a full developer SDK, force-sensor feet, and support for an external NVIDIA Jetson Orin module, while Air, Pro, and X ship as closed, non-developer configurations. Go2 EDU also carries no public price — Unitree quotes it only through direct sales, unlike the other tiers' published $1,600–$4,500 range.
